title: Files on Azure Blob Storage: destination

url.title: URL
url.description: Where the tables go: azblob://container/prefix. Each stream's table is a directory of files under it.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: The blob service's URL, for one other than https://ACCOUNT.blob.core.windows.net, such as Azurite's http://127.0.0.1:10000/devstoreaccount1. Not with connectionString, which names its own. With sasToken, it needs https.

accountName.title: Account name
accountName.description: The storage account. Needed with accountKey, sasToken or Azure's default credentials, unless the endpoint names it.

accountKey.title: Account key
accountKey.description: The account's shared key. Set at most one of accountKey, sasToken and connectionString; without any, Azure's default credentials.

sasToken.title: SAS token
sasToken.description: A shared access signature for the container, the query string it is. It goes in each request's URL, so it needs an https endpoint.

connectionString.title: Connection string
connectionString.description: The account's connection string, which names the account and its key or a SAS, and the endpoint, so it doesn't go with endpoint. With a SAS, its endpoint needs https.

format.title: Format
format.description: The files' format: Parquet, CSV with a header line, or JSON Lines.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Parquet: zstd (the default), snappy, gzip or none, inside the file. CSV and JSON Lines: gzip, zstd or none (the default), the whole file, which gets the extension .gz or .zst.

fileSize.title: File size
fileSize.description: Bytes a file reaches, compressed, before the next one starts: 1 MiB to 4 GiB.

x-groups.title: Location
x-groups.description: Where the files are, and the address of the store's API.

x-groups.title: Files
x-groups.description: How each table's files are written.
